device_note: rr sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES per pool; the pool GPU is cuda:0 in-process

train.definition_change: change_i = h_new_i - h_original_i is a 64-d vector; the reported magnitude is ||change_i||_2 per atom, averaged over atoms that receive the correction (hetero)
train.definition_change_component_abs: per hetero atom mean_j |change_ij|, then averaged

valid420.definition_change: change_i = h_new_i - h_original_i is a 64-d vector; the reported magnitude is ||change_i||_2 per atom, averaged over atoms that receive the correction (hetero)
valid420.definition_change_component_abs: per hetero atom mean_j |change_ij|, then averaged

w_out_zero_ablation_valid.note: full trained model vs the same trained model with W_out zeroed in eval (its own base path)

dropout.eval_forward_diff_note: non-zero only from float32 reduction order, not dropout

roleblind_usage.definition: compare m_all = mean(h over all atoms) with mean(h over hetero atoms) of the same molecule

model_audit.context_definition: hetero-only h_new = h + W_out(tanh(W_atom h) * tanh(W_het m_all) * tanh(W_ch m_all)); m_all = mean over all atoms of the molecule; y = sum f(h_new) + rho(original h statistics)

recipe.dropout_position: final atom-level local h (v2 DropoutAtLocal on model.local)
